description: Installation of secondary glazing to second floor windows on front elevation
decision_conditions: <p>The colour and finish of the frame should match or appear visually recessive in terms of the existing window frame and surround.</p><p>REASON: To protect the significance of the Listed Building</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d5ff22bb-7fff-3982-9d73-26fab118d0ab"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The secondary glazing shall be fixed to the surrounding internal reveal (the plaster or timber recess) rather than screwing or fixing directly into the original historic window.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To prevent any permanent harm to the existing windows.</span></p>
